nodes.label: Spec 0002: Standards and tooling
nodes.rationale: Gives the workspace seven required checks so written rules become enforced and a broken rule fails by itself.

nodes.label: scripts/check.sh check entry point
nodes.rationale: One POSIX shell command per check used by people and CI, so a failed CI job is reproduced locally with the same command; exit codes 0/1/2/3.

nodes.label: Seven required checks (fmt, clippy, test, deny, linux-build, guards, docs)
nodes.rationale: The check name is the same everywhere: script argument, workflow job id and branch rule context.

nodes.label: Dependency policy (deny.toml)
nodes.rationale: cargo-deny 0.20.2 covers advisories, licenses, bans and sources in one file; allow list is exactly Apache-2.0, MIT, Unicode-3.0 plus NCSA for libfuzzer-sys, so the list cannot grow quietly.

nodes.label: Workspace Clippy lint rules
nodes.rationale: Denies dbg_macro, print_stderr, print_stdout, todo, unimplemented; turns spec 0001 output rule into a lint. unwrap/expect/panic stay a review item.

nodes.label: pool-repo-check repository check program
nodes.rationale: Dependency-free Rust program outside the Cargo workspace so scope 001 member and lockfile criteria stay true; holds workspace, CI and document guards.

nodes.label: scripts/linux-build.sh Linux build script
nodes.rationale: Executable byte-for-byte copy of the spec 0001 Linux build command; spec 0001 stays the only owner of platform and image.

nodes.label: Workspace guards W1-W7
nodes.rationale: Baseline files that a spec changes on purpose make every package, path, socket or crate change visible in a diff.

nodes.label: W3 forbidden source patterns guard
nodes.rationale: Plain text match equal to the grep of 0001 AC-12.

nodes.label: W7 Linux build command copy guard
nodes.rationale: Keeps scripts/linux-build.sh equal to spec 0001 Linux build block.

nodes.label: CI definition guards C1-C5
nodes.rationale: Line based readers over fixed-shape ci.yml and main.json, no YAML/JSON parser needed.

nodes.label: C1 actions pinned by commit hash
C2 job ids equal required status check contexts
C3 CI runs only scripts/check.sh
nodes.rationale: Keeps CI free of logic of its own so local reproduction cannot drift.

nodes.label: Document checks D1-D6
nodes.rationale: Scope status and requirement IDs are particular to this repository, so no off the shelf tool covers them.

nodes.label: D2 link fragment is a heading anchor
D3 scope index and feature files agree
nodes.rationale: Allows tags such as 'needs a decision' after the status because 14 of 17 feature files carry it.

nodes.label: D5 every cited ID is defined
D6 IDs of base revision still defined
nodes.rationale: Compares with git base revision rather than a committed ID list, avoiding a second owner of the same fact.

nodes.label: Fuzz harness (pool-config-fuzz, validate target)
nodes.rationale: One target for pool_config::validate, the only code parsing untrusted bytes; cargo-fuzz 0.13.2 on nightly-2026-10-17; not a required check yet.

nodes.label: Software inventory (CycloneDX SBOM)
nodes.rationale: cargo-cyclonedx 0.5.10 writes target/sbom/pool.cdx.json as SEC-13 evidence; a command, not a required check, until scope 011.

nodes.label: CI definition (.github/workflows/ci.yml)
nodes.rationale: GitHub Actions on ubuntu-24.04-arm, same architecture as the Linux target; read-only token, no secrets, daily run finds new advisories.

nodes.label: Branch rule and change path (main ruleset)
nodes.rationale: Ruleset with no bypass actors; main reached only via pull request with seven passed checks and merge commit; 0 approvals because one account cannot approve its own PR.

nodes.label: Proving the checks (scripts/prove-checks.sh, 21 cases)
nodes.rationale: A check is trusted only after it has been seen to fail against a deliberately wrong change.

nodes.label: Remote proof (remote steps 1-7)
nodes.rationale: Only steps that write to GitHub; run by the lead with scope permission, never by build sessions.

nodes.label: Rules for later slices (PostgreSQL 18 integration, fuzzing, new members, notices)
nodes.rationale: Official postgres Debian image pinned by digest started by scripts/check.sh integration; no services: block because it cannot run on a workstation.

nodes.label: Reviewer roster and fresh model reviews
nodes.rationale: Fresh model may do independent slice reviews; approvals needing authority over infrastructure, licenses, risk, releases or the remote need a named person; owner stands in for three unassigned roles.

nodes.label: Document corrections (13 items)
nodes.rationale: Sentences false for the current workspace are replaced; item 12 waits for remote evidence.

nodes.label: AC-3 The checks run in CI
AC-11 Each check catches a wrong change, locally
AC-12 A failed check blocks a merge, on the remote
AC-20 Lint rules that were only written down

nodes.rationale: Tracer bullet order: policy and entry point first, then CI files, guards, proof, documents and evidence.
